def test_largest_prime_factor():
    # Basic composite number
    assert largest_prime_factor(15) == 5      # factors: 3, 5

    # Classic example
    assert largest_prime_factor(13195) == 29  # factors: 5, 7, 13, 29

    # Prime number is its own largest prime factor
    assert largest_prime_factor(13) == 13
    assert largest_prime_factor(2) == 2
    assert largest_prime_factor(3) == 3

    # Power of a single prime
    assert largest_prime_factor(16) == 2      # 2^4
    assert largest_prime_factor(27) == 3      # 3^3
    assert largest_prime_factor(125) == 5     # 5^3

    # Larger composite numbers
    assert largest_prime_factor(100) == 5     # 2^2 * 5^2
    assert largest_prime_factor(84) == 7      # 2^2 * 3 * 7
    assert largest_prime_factor(9973) == 9973 # prime

    # Product of two primes
    assert largest_prime_factor(6) == 3       # 2 * 3
    assert largest_prime_factor(35) == 7      # 5 * 7

    # Large known case
    assert largest_prime_factor(600851475143) == 6857

    print("All tests passed!")


# Run tests
test_largest_prime_factor()
